{{Quote|I'm wandering through this half-bombed village in the Kuthard backcountry with a pack of Coruscant News Net journalists and a world-weary Tynnan diplomat. The newsies find this old Dimok matriarch and start asking her about the war.|Gar Stazi to Jhoram Bey|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
A [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] '''diplomat''' [[Peacekeeping mission to the Sepan sector|traveled]] with [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuthard]] in [[137 ABY]]. While on the planet, the Tynnan fruitlessly attempted to persuade a [[Unidentified Dimok crone|matriarch]] of the [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] to surrender land to the opposing [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] during the [[Sepan Civil War]] between the two [[Subspecies/Legends|races]] of the [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'm thinking about peace, the old Dimok is waiting to see if we're done with her, and the Tynnan's just standing there with this funny little smile on his face.|Gar Stazi on the Tynnan's demeanor|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
[[File:Tyn.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The diplomat was a member of the Tynnan species.]]
A [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] accompanied [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and several [[Coruscant News Network]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporters]] on an observation [[Peacekeeping mission to the Sepan sector|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kuthard]] in the<ref name="TEGW" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]]</ref> [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]] in [[137 ABY]]. The Tynnan traveled with Stazi and the reporters to a [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] [[Unidentified Kuthard village|village]], where they met with an [[Unidentified Dimok crone|elderly Dimok matriarch]]; after asking her about the ongoing [[Sepan Civil War]] between her [[Subspecies/Legends|people]] and the opposing [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]], the reporters promptly moved on, leaving Stazi and his companion to talk to the elder.<ref name="TEGW" />

Catching Stazi's [[Eye/Legends|eye]] with a smile, and equipped with knowledge of property claims, past atrocities, and peace proposals relative to the locality of the Dimok matriarch's village, the Tynnan posed several questions to the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] concerning her family and proposed that the Dimok hand over a small parcel of her family's land to the Ripoblus to settle an outstanding claim. The elder vehemently refused his proposal, declaring that she would [[Death/Legends|die]] before doing so. Stazi later recounted the story to [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Jhoram Bey]] via [[Holomessage/Legends|holomessage]], using it to illustrate a point that the peoples of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were predisposed to war.<ref name="TEGW" />

==Personality and traits==
The Tynnan sported [[Color/Legends|gray]] whiskers and was considered world-weary by Stazi, though he was not incapable of smiling.<ref name="TEGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tynnan diplomat was introduced in the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGW" />
